body: [{"streamId":"01a0bae8-b1c2-762c-9a90-890d693ffe5d","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskAdded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a0bae8-b1c2-762c-9a90-890d693ffe5d\u0022,\u0022ProjectId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:\u0022An owner can place a task on one of their own nodes: h9k task assign --node \\u003Cnode\\u003E records the placement, only that node\\u0027s dispatcher claims it, and every other node of the same owner stands down without a forced take\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022h9k task assign \\u003Cid\\u003E --node \\u003Cnode-id or unambiguous fragment\\u003E records a node placement on the task (a project-scoped event that replicates), refuses a node not vouched into the owner\\u0027s fleet for that project, and h9k task show and h9k status name the placed node\u0022,\u0022DispatchEngine on any node of the same owner declines to claim a task placed on another node, logging the reason once per sweep at debug level, and claims it when the placement names this node; a task with no placement behaves exactly as today (first free dispatcher of the owner claims)\u0022,\u0022h9k task assign \\u003Cid\\u003E --node with no node named clears the placement; a forced or cooperative take that moves the task to another node records that node as the new placement so the old node stands down after a takeover without a second command\u0022,\u0022Unit tests cover: a placed task is skipped by a non-placed node and claimed by the placed node; an unplaced task is unchanged; the refusal for an unknown node; a takeover rewrites the placement; no test creates branches or touches GitHub\u0022,\u0022dotnet build and dotnet test pass; the decision log carries one entry under this task\\u0027s placeholder; docs/concepts.md says how placement, ownership, and takeover relate\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Cut 2026-09-19 14:2x EDT by the hall9k project window after the first two-node placement went wrong. Evidence: Brian said \\u0027Publish a56cf16e. Assign it on the Windows node.\\u0027 Assignment is per owner (h9k task assign --help: \\u0027Only that owner\\u0027s nodes may claim it\\u0027); both nodes are his; the tracker-assignee claim gate cannot separate two installs sharing one GitHub login; ProjectSettingsChanged is NodeScoped so per-project caps bound how many, never which. The Mac assigned a56cf16e at 14:21 while its board read 3 of 3 live, a run delivered in the same seconds, and the Mac\\u0027s DispatchEngine claimed it at 14:21:55 (run 01a0bae7) instead of Windows; the correction was a forced take from Windows (h9k task take --force, v0.10.0). Related: the persona stack (ec35ceca and children) that Brian wants built on Windows, and the mailbox relay that carries placement today by hand. Lineage: a gap in the distributed-team design (idea 202383dc), not a fix of a fix. Boundaries: placement is advisory to dispatch only; it never changes ownership, the ledger holder, or the claim gate; keep the takeover path as the override.\u0022,\u0022Constraints\u0022:null,\u0022ExternalReference\u0022:null,\u0022AddedAt\u0022:\u00222026-09-19T18:23:27.174437\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022AddedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022Model\u0022:\u0022\u0022,\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:[],\u0022StartsAsDraft\u0022:true,\u0022SourceIdeaId\u0022:null,\u0022EpicId\u0022:null,\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:null,\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:null,\u0022PreApproved\u0022:false,\u0022Origin\u0022:null,\u0022PreApproval\u0022:\u0022Off\u0022,\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:null,\u0022SecondaryExternalReference\u0022:null}","originEventId":"49cbb17d-24d9-4e0d-9269-361dd3d7c981","originSequence":30252,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-09-19T18:23:27.210731+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
